paragraphs.text: Pull back from everything and tend inward: that is how you arrive face to face. Welcome the boundless, enter it, and take one vow — imagine nothing.

Dive the streamed lakes and watch the inert stuff get stirred. Trust the five doings as Shiva-I. Get yourself counted and weighed by the teachers word, and you count as accomplished. Dream yourself fire-flamed and you shine like the sun.
Last measure: the measurer and the measured are one, fourteen-formed.
